note: IP-neutral (issue #51). Companion droids: three kinds, each with look variants. Not LLM characters; they only beep. The player runs up to max_owned at once. They show in the inventory as droids; what a cargo droid carries does not show, and the Remnant never searches it. Prices: the merchant sells at price and buys back at resale. Looks: each kind's 'look' names its Hyper3D model (issue #25, content/look/gear_models.json), tinted by the variant's body colour ('tint' 0..1), with glowing 'eyes' and a 'muzzle' in model space (metres, facing -Z, standing on y = 0). No model = the droid_kit.gd primitives. Following (issue #25 follow-up): a droid stays put until the player is 'leash' metres away, then walks to its slot and stops within 'settle'.

taming.note: Block or deflect this many of the range remote's bolts in a row (a bolt that hits you resets the count) and it follows you home. Oda drops the hint as a rumor (rumors/port_town.json, r_remote_tame).

wrecks.note: Broken droids stranded in the desert. On the home planet's ball the first visit seeds ball_starting_count wrecks across the whole sphere, then every check_seconds of play, with this chance, one more turns up until ball_max_out. They stay at least ball_min_radius from town and ball_min_separation apart along the surface. Flat worlds keep max_out and the ring radii. Fixing one takes fix_seconds; it resets and follows you.

pit_hauler.note: Issue #64: an old cargo droid that rattles round the landing pit, like T-89 a fixture of the pit. Nobody owns it. It carries the pickup named by 'carries' (pickups/port_town.json, pit_jetpack) on its back until someone takes it ([E] beside it, the same pickup as before, so saves still know it is taken). route: pit floor points (town coordinates) it walks in turn, stopping pause_s at each. Oda knows it as a rumor (rumors/port_town.json, r_pit_hauler).

remnant.note: Issue #64: outpost_unit is the assassin droid each desert outpost keeps (walking the outpost's 'patrol' points). The Remnant's own droids: they patrol the main street, share the Remnant's standing (they turn on you when the garrison would), sound the town alarm when they see trouble, and fight. Killing one costs Remnant standing like a trooper.

wreck.note: Issue #148: what is left of the Remnant aboard the crashed starcruiser (src/systems/world/starcruiser_wreck.gd). routes: patrol points in one of the wreck's frames ('level': x, height v, stern-ward w, unpitched; 'hull': the pitched ship's own parts() frame), turned into world points by StarcruiserWreck.site_point. units walk their route and shoot on sight; they answer to no garrison, so nothing out there sounds the town's alarm. A destroyed one comes back on its route after respawn_s. hauler: an old cargo droid in the deep hold with the pickup named by 'carries' (pickups/port_town.json, wreck_red_saber) on its back, like the pit hauler.
